feed.tag_title.description: Title of the Atom feed of a hashtag, and of the link to it in the hashtag's page. {tag} is the hashtag without #; {instance} is the name of the server.

feed.untitled.description: Title of a post in an Atom feed when the post has no text to take its title from (pictures only, say). {name} is the author's display name, or the username when there is none.

feed.content_warning.defaultMessage: Content warning: {warning}. Open the post to read it.
feed.content_warning.description: Text of a post in an Atom feed when the post has a content warning: the feed shows only the warning, and the body and the media stay on the post's page. {warning} is the warning, written by the author.
